title: Install the approved pre-append W1.A04 bootstrap lane

supplementalBootstrap.exceptionReason: The independently approved GRR-0002.B00 left its supplement installer at revision 4 and required the exact repair amendment to exist before a same-hold supplement could authorize its append. GCR-0001 has independently adopted the bounded generation-neutral, witness-aware controller at revision 7; this sequential bootstrap is still mandatory to activate and independently qualify that path before the original W1.A04.B00 submission can be retried.
requiredOutcomes: Install exactly one sequential GRR-0002.S01/GRR-0002.B01 record under the existing HOLD-W1-GRR-0002 and advance control revision and minimum tool revision from 7 to 8 without creating, replacing, or releasing a hold.

Authenticate the exact GRR-0002 packet, approval, B00 review, adopted GCR revision-7 generation, ECR-0003 packet, W1.A04 approval, blocked W1.A04.B00 candidate, and witness bytes while W1.A04 remains absent.

Require the exact unchanged, unstaged, untracked, non-authoritative W1.A04.B00 witness at supplement start, submission, remediation, and review, rejecting every missing, changed, staged, redirected, duplicated, authority-bearing, or accompanied workspace state.
Freeze criterion-linked B01 evidence and independent severity-ranked review append-only, with no open blocking finding before B01 becomes APPROVED.

After B01 approval, permit only a retry of the original packet-bound W1.A04.B00 submission; amendment materialization, task activation or claim, live T03 recovery, hold release, W1 resume, and gate approval remain separately gated.
Preserve product, privacy, approved-reference, task-acceptance, completed-task, release-gate, predecessor-authority, and prior GCR/GRR/ECR evidence bytes and outcomes.
prohibitedOutcomes: No new or competing hold, GRR-0002.B00 reopening, prior attempt rewrite, arbitrary controller generation, direct backlog edit, force, override, bypass, or skip-review path.

No W1.A04 append, bootstrap submission, materialization, activation, task claim, CAP-02.S04.T03 recovery, hold release, ordinary W1 resume, G1 approval, local-main integration, or remote push before their own lawful gates.

No product/runtime, privacy policy, approved UI reference, UI evidence, task acceptance criterion, completed-task outcome, Wave approval, release gate, verification threshold, or predecessor Git-object change.
No use, staging, tracking, mutation, deletion, redirection, duplication, or authority promotion of the atomic-failure witness.

acceptanceCriteria: The exact v2 packet validates against Draft 2020-12, all declared hashes match, and the GRR-0002, GCR revision-7, ECR-0003/W1.A04, blocked bootstrap, and witness authority commits and blobs remain exact and ancestral.
The pre-install boundary is control revision 7 with one ACTIVE HOLD-W1-GRR-0002, APPROVED GRR-0002.B00, PAUSED W1 at wave scope, absent W1.A04, BLOCKED CAP-02.S04.T03, and PENDING G1.

Supplement start atomically installs only the sequential GRR-0002.S01/GRR-0002.B01 record, advances revision and minimum tool revision to 8, and leaves W1, T03, W1.A04, the active hold, and all prior histories otherwise unchanged.

The exact witness-aware workspace contract is applied consistently to start, submit/resubmit, and review and denies every missing, changed, staged, tracked, redirected, duplicated, authority-bearing, or accompanied deviation without mutation.

B01 submission freezes the exact candidate, approval-to-candidate changed paths, criteria, checks, and evidence; independent review is append-only, severity-ranked, and cannot approve with an open blocking finding.

An independently APPROVED B01 validates a read-only projection of only the original W1.A04.B00 retry while amendment append/materialization, task execution, live T03 recovery, hold release, W1 resume, and G1 remain unauthorized.
Focused real-Git recovery, older-reader, stale-writer, atomicity, authority, quality, backlog/view, review-site, scope, and Git-hygiene checks pass with no protected product or reference change.

The packet receives independent exact-commit control/security review with no open finding before human approval, and B01 receives a separate independent commit-bound approval before W1.A04.B00 is retried.
verificationObligations: Validate the packet schema and every declared file hash, Git blob, introduction commit, ancestry edge, control-generation record, base recovery authority, and target amendment authority.
Run the real-Git GRR-0002.S01 lifecycle through start, B01 submission, independent review, and approved validation without mocking cleanliness, plus the exact witness deviation matrix.
Replay affected recoveryctl, taskctl schema/workflow, older-reader, transaction, stale-writer, and atomic-no-write checks selected by the shared control-plane risk surface.

Validate the read-only target materialization projection, canonical backlog, GRR-0002 and GCR-0001 authority, ECR-0003 approval, generated views, review site, governed Python quality, protected scope, and Git diff hygiene.

Bind B01 evidence to the exact approval-introduction-to-candidate diff, every required outcome and acceptance criterion, unique passing checks, deferred broader W1 qualification, and an empty unverified list.
Independently review this exact inert packet before human approval and independently review the exact B01 candidate before retrying only W1.A04.B00.
rollback: Before packet approval, reject, defer, or retain the inert files while the revision-7 stopped state, active hold, absent amendment, blocked task, and exact witness remain unchanged.
Before B01 approval, an adverse review preserves the attempt, evidence, findings, and stopped boundary and requires a strict-descendant in-scope resubmission with explicit closures.
If any authority, witness, control generation, hold, W1 pause, amendment absence, task block, or atomicity condition fails, stop without installing, submitting, reviewing, or retrying anything.
Never delete, replace, rewrite, synthesize, or repurpose prior GRR, GCR, supplement, approval, attempt, ECR, amendment, task, evidence, finding, checkpoint, or Git history.

alternatives.title: Approve bounded B01 supplement
alternatives.consequence: Uses the reviewed append-only lane under the existing hold and enables only the next independently reviewed bootstrap boundary.

alternatives.title: Keep recovery and W1 paused
alternatives.consequence: Makes no mutation, but W1.A04 and CAP-02.S04.T03 cannot progress.

alternatives.title: Defer or withdraw append-only
alternatives.consequence: Requires a governed disposition and provides no implicit authority to resume W1.

alternatives.title: Direct edit or immediate W1.A04 retry
alternatives.consequence: Would bypass mandatory supplement packet, human approval, and independent B01 review gates.

requiredApprovalStatement: Approve GRR-0002.S01 at packet commit <40-character SHA>, authorizing only supplemental bootstrap GRR-0002.B01 and its hash-bound scope under HOLD-W1-GRR-0002. Keep W1 paused, W1.A04 absent, CAP-02.S04.T03 blocked, and G1 pending through independent B01 approval; after B01 approval, retry only the original packet-bound W1.A04.B00 submission.
